toegepas.voor: het 'n eie naam, en dit is geraasbesoedeling.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'en dit is' is wooden here; a colon introduces the name more naturally and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'het 'n eie naam, en dit is geraasbesoedeling' is a stiff, roundabout way to introduce a name
toegepas.rede_keurder: The colon gives the name directly and more naturally, with the same meaning, and the protected term stays.

laat_vaar.voor: baie kinders wat gelyk op die speelgrond skree
laat_vaar.na: baie kinders wat tegelyk op die speelgrond skree
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'tegelyk' is the standard word for 'at the same time'; 'gelyk' can also be read as 'equally' or 'level'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'gelyk' meaning 'at the same time' is normal, natural Afrikaans and cannot be misread in this phrase, so this is a lateral move.

na_skrywer.blok: Hoe jy jou ore veilig hou
na_skrywer.voor: Daar help dit dat jy self kies hoe hard hulle speel.
na_skrywer.na: Dan help dit as jy self kies hoe hard hulle speel.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Daar help dit dat' reads as a calque; 'Dan help dit as' is the natural Afrikaans construction with the same meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Daar help dit dat' is stiff and leaves it unclear whether it states a fact (you control the volume) or gives advice
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a safety instruction (what to do with earphones), and changing 'Daar' to 'Dan' and 'dat' to 'as' shifts the nuance from fact to condition, so the writer must fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Dit help baie mense wat sag hoor om te hoor wat rondom hulle gebeur.
vlae.rede: 'sag hoor om te hoor' repeats the verb and reads slightly clumsily, but 'mense wat sag hoor' is protected and any smoother wording (e.g. 'beter hoor') would change the claim; left for the writer to judge.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoe jy jou ore veilig hou
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Draai dit sagter as die klank uit 'n TV of 'n foon kom.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: As die klank uit 'n TV of 'n foon kom, draai dit sagter.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: dit points forward to a noun not yet named; putting the condition first gives the pronoun its referent.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: dit reads back to the loud sound in the previous sentence, so the reorder is a lateral move inside a safety instruction.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoe jy jou ore veilig hou
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: harde masjiene can read as solid machines; raserig means noisy and shares its root with geraas.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: In this lesson hard is the volume word, so 'harde masjiene' reads as loud machines and raserig is a lateral swap away from the lesson's own vocabulary.
